GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Oceans, Seas and Coasts is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Oceans, Seas and Coasts as rumours only.
   B. Explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Oceans, Seas and Coasts.
   D. Say Oceans, Seas and Coasts never happens in Kenya.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

4. Which statement about Action of wind and water in arid areas is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Action of wind and water in arid areas never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Action of wind and water in arid areas as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Action of wind and water in arid areas.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

6. Which statement about Underground Water is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Underground Water never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Underground Water.
   C. Treat Underground Water as rumours only.
   D. Explain Underground Water with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   C. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

9. Which statement about Karst Scenery is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Karst Scenery never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Karst Scenery with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Karst Scenery as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Karst Scenery.

10. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   B. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.

11. Which statement about Lakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Lakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Lakes as rumours only.
   C. Say Lakes never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Lakes.

12. Which statement about Glaciation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Glaciation.
   B. Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Glaciation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Glaciation as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Action of wind and water in arid areas and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. A — Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. B — Explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. C — Explain symbols used on a map

4. A — Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. C — Obeying laws and caring for public property

6. D — Explain Underground Water with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. D — Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. B — Plan income and spending wisely

9. B — Explain Karst Scenery with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. C — Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A — Explain Lakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. B — Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Statistical Methods; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Elementary Surveying; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Geographic Information Systems; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Action of wind and water in arid areas; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
